All seven

All seven, every time.

Every room needs the whole list, held in one hand. That is the job, and the pleasure of it.

Method

A method for the monumental.

Every environment begins as a question and ends as a memory. The path between is deliberate — equal parts strategy and craft, ambition and discipline.

Step Discover
STEP 01

Discover

Immersion in the subject — its history, intent and audience — until the central story reveals itself.

You receive a research deck and the one central story
STEP 02

Direct

A unifying creative vision that aligns designers, architects, writers, producers and technologists toward one outcome.

You receive a concept book and a walkthrough film
STEP 03

Craft

Space, light, motion and interaction composed into environments that engage intellectually, emotionally and physically.

You receive detail drawings, media scripts and a prototype room
STEP 04

Deliver

Concept to launch — balancing creative ambition with operational discipline. On scale, on story, on time.

You receive a built, tested and opened experience

Sanzeed MirzaExperiential Design Consultant
About

Strategy, craft and calm leadership, in one person.

I’m an experiential design consultant based in New Delhi, working with institutions and brands wherever the project is. Fifteen years in: first as a concept artist and VFX lead on films and animation, then eight years directing museums, experience centres, pavilions and shows.

I lead the whole room — story, space, graphics, media and the team that builds it. The work I want to make is calm to run and impossible to forget once you have walked through it.

i.

Strategic Vision

Transforming complex ideas into cohesive, purposeful stories — concept through launch.

ii.

Immersive Craft

Environments that engage intellectually, emotionally, and physically across every touchpoint.

iii.

Calm Leadership

Guiding designers, writers, architects, producers and technologists toward unified outcomes.

Journey

Fifteen years, one through-line.

Aug 2026 — Present

Experiential Design Consultant

Independent Consultant

Partnering directly with museums, cultural institutions and brands as an independent consultant — leading experience vision, narrative and design direction from first concept to opening day.

What that involved
  • Advising institutions on experience strategy, visitor journey and interpretive storytelling.
  • Directing spatial, visual and immersive design across museums, experience centres and memorials.
  • Guiding projection mapping, interactive media and show-control teams through delivery.
  • Available for select consulting, creative direction and collaboration mandates.
Jun 2018 — Jul 2026

Creative Director

Tagbin

Leading creative strategy and execution for high-profile digital museums, immersive exhibitions and cultural experiences at national scale — transforming complex ideas into tech-enabled visitor journeys.

What that involved
  • Directed the creative vision for national-level projects commissioned by ministries and top institutions.
  • Led interdisciplinary teams across physical and digital spatial storytelling.
  • Designed interactive, multimedia environments using AR/VR, sensor-based tech and data visualization.
  • Managed complete project cycles — concept to launch — ensuring innovation, quality and timely execution.
Apr 2018 — May 2018

Creative Head

Digital Web Solutions

Led the creative department of a fast-paced agency, developing brand identities and integrated campaigns across digital and print.

What that involved
  • Oversaw a team of designers and content creators for high-impact, cohesive visual output.
  • Directed multi-platform campaigns aligned with client goals and user engagement.
Feb 2017 — Mar 2018

Creative Director

SocioPixels

Led the visual direction and creative execution for animated films, multimedia content and experiential installations.

What that involved
  • Defined the artistic and narrative framework for diverse visual storytelling projects.
  • Mentored cross-functional creative teams to maintain high production standards.
  • Aligned visual concepts with messaging and delivery goals alongside clients and technical teams.
Sep 2011 — Dec 2016

Lead Concept Artist

Broadcast2world

Crafted high-impact visual narratives that helped brands communicate complex ideas with clarity and emotion.

What that involved
  • Designed concept art, storyboards and visual scripts for animated content across industries and formats.
  • Established the visual identity for numerous client projects, ensuring storytelling consistency.
  • Helped scale the studio’s signature visual language, serving clients like PwC, Microsoft & Discovery.
Sep 2011 — Dec 2016 · in parallel

VFX Artist

Prime Focus

Contributed to the production of high-end visual effects for international film and media projects.

What that involved
  • Executed rotoscoping and compositing for international VFX projects, ensuring seamless CGI integration.
  • Collaborated with VFX leads to meet tight production schedules while maintaining quality and visual continuity.
